components.role: video instance segmentation and identity-preserving tracking
components.licenseReview: Apache-2.0 code/checkpoints reported upstream; verify exact artifacts before distribution
components.notes: Tracks the selected dog or dogs through video. It does not assign behavior or emotional meaning.
Provides body geometry and motion features. Dog-specific calibration/fine-tuning should be evaluated separately.
Useful for active-learning and owner-consented dog-specific pose refinement when generic pose models struggle with morphology or camera viewpoint.

components.role: animal action video representation and recognition
components.licenseReview: MIT code reported upstream; independently review pretrained weights and source datasets
components.notes: Open implementation and pretrained model are available. Must be benchmarked on dog-specific, real-owner video before product use.

CVPR 2026 work reports AnimalBand with 74,671 videos and 160 visually observable behavior labels. Repository currently states EthoCLIP code/weights remain a TODO, so do not make this a runtime dependency yet.

components.licenseReview: manual is accessible; associated training/test videos may not be reused without written permission
components.notes: Use DogFACS terminology to describe facial movements, never as a direct emotion classifier and never train on restricted manual/test videos without permission.

components.role: per-pet calibration, context baseline, handler-intervention response model
components.notes: Owner-corrected observations and repeated paired sessions update individual baselines. Breed is not an input to the adaptation policy.
